author: Chase Davis
title: Michael McGreevy deals six scoreless in no-decision vs. Marlins
desc: Michael McGreevy allowed zero earned runs on five hits and one walk while striking out four over six innings in Friday's loss to the Marlins.
impact: McGreevy now owns a 3.12 ERA and 1.14 WHIP with a 3-6 record through 16 starts this season. This was a nice bounce-back performance after giving up five runs in five innings last time out. He'll look to keep it going against the Braves next week.

author: Chase Davis
title: Mookie Betts' lone blast can't prevent 7-1 loss to Padres
desc: Mookie Betts went 1-for-3 in loss to the Padres with a home run, a run scored and one RBI.
impact: Through 47 games, Betts is batting .231 with 10 home runs, 22 RBI, 29 runs scored and one stolen base. His solo shot was the only damage they could muster against former Dodger Walker Buehler. Over his last 12 games, Betts is batting .375 with four homers, 11 runs scored and five RBI.

author: Chase Davis
title: Roki Sasaki's command vanishes in short start vs. Padres
desc: Roki Sasaki allowed three earned runs on three hits and five walks while striking out two over four innings in Friday's loss to the Padres.
impact: After the defeat, Sasaki now owns a 4.88 ERA and 1.33 WHIP with a 3-5 record across 14 starts. He threw just 38 of his 81 pitches for strikes and gave up six hard-hit balls. Since the best start of his career on June 5, he's allowed 13 earned runs on 14 hits and nine walks while striking out 12 over 14 innings through three starts. He gets the Padres again next.

author: Chase Davis
title: Steven Cruz fans three as opener as Royals take thrashing
desc: Steven Cruz struck out three batters while allowing no hits and no earned runs, walking one over 1.1 frames in Friday's loss to the White Sox.
impact: Cruz now has a 5.92 ERA and 1.52 WHIP with a 12.2 K/9 across 22 appearances this season. He got the game started with four clean outs before Mitch Spence took over and allowed 10 runs in his four outs.

author: Nate Miller
title: Jhoan Duran converts save chance Friday night
desc: Jhoan Duran allowed zero runs on one hit and no walks while striking out one during a scoreless ninth inning in Friday's 2-1 win over the Mets.
impact: Duran grabbed his 20th save of the season Friday night, working around a two-out single to preserve a one-run win for the Phillies. Duran has blown only one save opportunity this season, posting a stellar 1.63 ERA and 44-5 K/BB ratio across 27 2/3 innings.

author: Nate Miller
title: Zack Wheeler shuts down Mets on Friday
desc: Zack Wheeler gave up just one run on four hits and one walk while striking out five across seven innings in Friday's 2-1 win over the Mets.
impact: Wheeler beat his former team for the second time within the past week on Friday night. The ace righty continues another sensational season, boasting a 2.03 ERA and 0.86 WHIP through a dozen starts. He will return to the mound Wednesday against the Pirates.

author: Nate Miller
title: Ozzie Albies drives in two Friday night
desc: Ozzie Albies went 1-for-3 with a single and two RBI in Friday's 3-1 win over the Giants.
impact: Albies had a couple of big at-bats for the slumping Braves on Friday, driving in a run with a single and another with a sacrifice fly. The switch-hitting second baseman has now driven in seven runs over the last six games, going 7-for-21 with two homers and a double in that span.

author: Nate Miller
title: Mauricio Dubon scores twice in Friday's win
desc: Mauricio Dubon went 2-for-5 with a couple of singles, a stolen base, and two runs scored in Friday's 3-1 win over the Giants.
impact: Dubon has been locked in at the plate throughout June, batting .312 with an .891 OPS while hitting safely in 17-of-20 games. The versatile veteran swiped just his second base of the season Friday night, and he's now up to a dozen runs scored with five homers, three doubles, and 14 RBI this month.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Wyatt Langford racks up three hits, swipes base in loss to Blue Jays
desc: Wyatt Langford went 3-for-5 in a win over the Blue Jays with a double, one run scored, and one stolen base.
impact: Langford continues a productive stretch, getting on base in 13 of his last 14 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more impactful bats in an underperforming Rangers lineup, carrying an .824 OPS with eight homers, 20 RBI, 23 runs scored, and six steals through 40 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Justin Foscue drives in three in win over Blue Jays
desc: Justin Foscue went 2-for-4 in a win over the Blue Jays with a home run, one run scored, and three RBI.
impact: Foscue continues a underwhelming stretch at the plate, picking up hits in three of his last 11 contests. The 27-year-old remains one of the more explosive bats in an inconsistent Rangers lineup, batting .268 with five home runs, 13 RBI, and 11 runs scored across 36 games.

author: Nate Miller
title: Raisel Iglesias slams the door on Giants
desc: Raisel Iglesias retired all three batters he faced during a spotless ninth inning to pick up a save in Friday's 3-1 win over the Giants.
impact: Iglesias picked up his 16th save of the season Friday night, as he quickly breezed through the side in order. The veteran closer continues his excellent season, sporting a 1.37 ERA, 1.06 WHIP, and 29 strikeouts through 26 1/3 innings.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ezequiel Duran chips in two hits, steal in win over Blue Jays
desc: Ezequiel Duran went 2-for-4 in a win over the Blue Jays with one RBI and one stolen base.
impact: Duran continues a steady stretch at the plate of late, driving in runs in five of his last 10 contests. The 27-year-old has provided manager Skip Schumaker with one of the more stable options in an inconsistent Rangers lineup, batting .265 with six home runs, 41 RBI, 32 runs scored, and six steals through 73 games

author: Chris Schommer
title: Nathan Eovaldi deals in win over Blue Jays
desc: Nathan Eovaldi allowed five hits and one walk while striking out nine over seven scoreless innings in Friday's win over the Blue Jays.
impact: Eovaldi has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three earned runs or more in six of his last seven trips to the mound. The right-hander remains another inconsistent option in the Rangers rotation to this point, carrying a 3.95 ERA and 1.16 WHIP with an 8-7 record and 9.1 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Nate Miller
title: Reynaldo Lopez logs three innings in return to rotation
desc: Reynaldo Lopez gave up one run on four hits and no walks while striking out one over three innings in Friday's 3-1 win against the Giants.
impact: After working out of the bullpen for the past two months, Lopez made his first start for the Braves since April 21 on Friday night. As expected, the veteran righty was on a limited workload, but he fared fairly well during his three frames. Lopez fired 57 pitches (35 strikes) and allowed just a single run in the opening inning. He now sports a 3.47 ERA for the campaign with a 40-21 K/BB ratio across 46 2/3 innings.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Willson Contreras goes yard in win over Yankees
desc: Willson Contreras went 2-for-3 in a win over the Yankees with a home run, one run scored, one walk, and two RBI.
impact: Contreras continues a solid stretch at the plate, recording hits in nine of his last 14 contests with nine RBI. The first baseman offers manager Chad Tracy one of the few reliable options in an inconsistent Red Sox lineup, posting a .900 OPS with 17 home runs, 48 RBI, 39 runs scored, and one stolen base across 78 games.
